projectDescription: A browser console script that automates TypingClub lessons by simulating keystrokes and automatically advancing through levels to achieve full scores.
keyFeatures: Automated keystroke simulation for TypingClub lessons
Automatic level advancement after each lesson completes
Configurable typing delay to avoid detection
Handles special characters including ENTER key and non-breaking spaces
Uses TypingClub's internal API (window.core.record_keydown_time) for reliable input
publicApiSurface: autoPlay() — starts the automation loop for the current level
getTargetCharacters() — reads the characters to type from the DOM
recordKey(chr) — sends a keystroke to TypingClub's internal API
goToNextLevel() — clicks the next-level button and restarts autoPlay
minDelay / maxDelay — configurable typing speed constants
